mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id AS attachmentId, a.business_type AS businessType, a.business_id AS businessId, CASE WHEN a.business_type = 'TENDER' THEN t.tender_name WHEN a.business_type = 'BID' THEN b.bid_name ELSE '未知业务' END AS businessName, a.file_type AS fileType, a.file_category AS fileCategory, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_path AS filePath, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.file_format AS fileFormat, a.file_md5 AS fileMd5, a.version_no AS versionNo, a.is_latest AS isLatest, a.upload_user_id AS uploadUserId, uu.user_name AS uploadUserName, ud.dept_name AS uploadDeptName, a.upload_time AS uploadTime, a.download_count AS downloadCount, a.last_download_time AS lastDownloadTime, a.file_status AS fileStatus, a.security_level AS securityLevel, a.created_by AS createdBy, cu.user_name AS createdByName, a.created_dept_id AS createdDeptId, cd.dept_name AS createdDeptName, a.created_post_id AS createdPostId, cp.post_name AS createdPostName, a.created_time AS createdTime, a.updated_time AS updatedTime, a.remark AS remark FROM exp_attachment a LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON a.business_type = 'TENDER' AND a.business_id = t.tender_id LEFT JOIN exp_bid b ON a.business_type = 'BID' AND a.business_id = b.bid_id LEFT JOIN exp_user uu ON a.upload_user_id = uu.user_id LEFT JOIN exp_dept ud ON uu.dept_id = ud.dept_id LEFT JOIN exp_user cu ON a.created_by = cu.user_id LEFT JOIN exp_dept cd ON a.created_dept_id = cd.dept_id LEFT JOIN exp_post cp ON a.created_post_id = cp.post_id WHERE a.attachment_id = #{attachmentId}

SELECT a.attachment_id AS attachmentId, a.business_type AS businessType, a.business_id AS businessId, CASE WHEN a.business_type = 'TENDER' THEN t.tender_name WHEN a.business_type = 'BID' THEN b.bid_name ELSE '未知业务' END AS businessName, a.file_type AS fileType, a.file_category AS fileCategory, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.file_format AS fileFormat, a.version_no AS versionNo, a.is_latest AS isLatest, u.user_name AS uploadUserName, a.upload_time AS uploadTime, a.download_count AS downloadCount, a.file_status AS fileStatus, a.security_level AS securityLevel, cu.user_name AS createdByName, a.created_time AS createdTime FROM exp_attachment a LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON a.business_type = 'TENDER' AND a.business_id = t.tender_id LEFT JOIN exp_bid b ON a.business_type = 'BID' AND a.business_id = b.bid_id LEFT JOIN exp_user u ON a.upload_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN exp_user cu ON a.created_by = cu.user_id WHERE a.business_type = #{businessType} AND a.business_id = #{businessId} ORDER BY a.created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE exp_attachment SET download_count = download_count + 1, last_download_time = NOW() WHERE attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
